g.text: Official Brand Guidelines: Gabriel Sans, Monogram Anatomy, Lockups, Type Scale, Surfaces & Lighting Architecture
1. Brand & Accent TokensCore highlights, CTAs, status indicators and interactive states (Dark & Light Contrast Parity)
Primary CTAs, selection glow, active navigation & tags
Tactile response: brighter in dark, richer in light
Secondary buttons, badges & lockup right-face stroke
Validation errors, critical failures & danger actions
Numeric metrics, step indicators & secondary telemetry
2. Canvas & Surface ArchitectureLayered depth hierarchy from deepest background to elevated modals
Root html, body background & terminal OSC 11 default
Docs sidebar pane, footer bar & root structure backing
Badges, code container substrate & chip backgrounds
Feature cards, secondary code cards & TUI forms
Active tabs, modal dialogs & floating popovers
Row highlight, active cursor & interactive menu hover
3. Typography System & Modular Type Scale (Gabriel Sans & Maple Mono)Mathematical type scale, calibrated line-heights, letter-spacing tracking & VS Code/Chroma syntax
Landing display titles, major release banners & page H1s
Feature cards, documentation sub-sections & modal dialogs
Paragraphs, technical docs, tooltips & suite overlines
Eliminates sRGB gray dead-zone between mint & pink
Official VS Code & Chroma terminal light syntax highlighting
4. Borders, Hairlines & Outlines (Dark & Light Parity)Stroke weights, frame definitions, translucent glass rims and interactive focus states
Internal lines, input borders & quiet separators
Navbar border, table borders & secondary container frames
Interactive focus ring, card hover & active tab indicator
Subtle outer border for glassmorphic card surfaces
Outline for secondary actions and cancel options
5. Lighting System & Frosted Glass ArchitectureAscending vertical spotlights, clean surface gradients and frosted glass recipe
6. Procedural Wave Backgrounds & 60/40 Horizon ArchitecturePolar logarithmic vortex wave field vs harmonic cross-wave field with 60/40 viewport gradient mask
100% Solid Darkening for Hero Title & Navbar
Dark Mode: Polar Logarithmic Vortex Surface
translate-y-28 sm:translate-y-40 scale-[1.08] (anchors center to bottom 3rd)
Prevents inter-voxel clipping and viewport background bleed-through
Three.js / WebGL dynamic voxel canvas in BackgroundGrid.astro
Smooth Sage Dissolve for High Contrast Reading
Superposition of multidirectional wave frequencies without central focus
Pine Crests (#137A5B) transition into Sage Troughs (#C6DECE / #E0EFE8)
Prevents viewport background bleed-through in light mode
7. Shape Language, Brand Monogram Anatomy & Official Lockup SuiteThe "Ch" Sculpted Monogram, Wordmark-First Lockup, Banner Architecture and Pure Sharp 0px Geometry
• TUI: Sidebar active item indicator bar (│)
• STRICT: Buttons and cards are NEVER rounded
• Web: Search inputs, cards & code boxes (0px)
• TUI: Modal dialogs, error frames & active tabs (0px)
• Strict rule: All rectangular UI elements are 100% straight
• Shell: Synchronizes Kitty, Alacritty & Ghostty bg
• Visual representation of the "Ch" suite prefix
• Used as standalone icon, favicon & seal
• 12px precise gap between name and cube
• Apps: Overline + App Name (Pelago, Styx, Ramble)
• Unified brand hierarchy across Web, CLI & TUI
8. UI Component Kit & Interactive State Matrix
Deterministic Micro-Interactions & Dual-Theme Contrast Parity • Strict 0px Sharp Edges
• Accessible sharp focus ring with 2px translucent offset
• Focus: glowing halo with 30-35% opacity spread
• Error validation: strawberry pink border & tint
• 100% straight orthogonal boxes without border radius
• 0px brutalist sharp switch tracks and knobs
• Glowing status nodes for real-time states
• Strict straight corners (0px) aligned with Ch-aOS brutalism
• Accessible color parity tuned for dark & light
• Segmented tab container with tactile active plate
• Card hover reveals directional top accent border
• Pure sharp geometry across all elevation tiers
• Instant tactile feedback on command click
• 0px straight Unix CLI chrome & status badges

Ch-aOS Design System & Brand Guidelines Architecture • Generated from Gabriel Sans, website/src/styles/global.css, src/themes/chaos.json, src/themes/chaos-dark.json, tui/views/theme.go & ui_helpers.go
